title.rendered: Ajanta Bottle & HNG share strong bond for past 40 years : S.K Mishra, VP Marketing, HNG &Industries

content.rendered:
Valuable Associate Feedback- Mr. M.L. Garg, HNG & Industries Limited

Thank you so much Mr. @gargmohan, Ex-General Manager, Marketing, @hng_india for taking out time to provide us with your valuable detailed feedback for @ajantabottle We are humbled by your words of appreciation and best wishes for Ajanta Bottle.

Sir, we fully agree with you that no customer is big or small. A customer is a customer. All customers need respect, quality, commitment, and excellent customer service. And we are happy that Ajanta Bottle has been able to fulfill customers’ needs for the past 40 years.

We will always cherish the memories and lessons learned in our almost 4 decades of association.

Looking forward to a much stronger association in the decades to come.

Wishing all the very best to you, @gargmohan sir.

To see Ajanta Bottle’s wide collection of glass bottles and glass jars and purchase online, visit https://zcu.io/H3kt.
